pages.text: A very busy day! El Marto Chisanga Mukuka Christian Mokuba
pages.alt: Book cover: Mama and child in a busy town.

pages.text: Today is a very busy day! Mama and I have lots of things to do and see.
pages.alt: Mama and child leave home together.

pages.text: We walk to the station and find people in a queue. Old people and young people, loud people and quiet people, all going to town.
Through the minibus window, I see cars driving by. Fast cars and slow cars, big cars and small cars.
There are so many buildings in town! Tall ones and short ones, glass ones and brick ones, everywhere I look.
Mama and I walk in and out of shops. Shops for clothes and shops for books, shops for bags and all sorts of things.
pages.alt: Mama and child look through shop windows.

pages.text: Mama tries on some shoes. Red shoes and green shoes, high shoes and low shoes.

pages.alt: A busy town scene invites looking together.

pages.text: In a big store, we fill a trolley with food. Boxes of cereal, and sacks of fruit. Bags of flour and bottles of juice.
pages.alt: Mama and child buy food at a store.

pages.text: Mama shows me the toys and asks me to choose! There are soft toys and round toys, loud toys and fast toys.
pages.alt: Mama and child look at toys.

pages.text: Today we’ve bought lots of things! Bags of food and bags of clothes. A pair of shoes and even some treats.
pages.alt: Mama and child carry their shopping.

pages.text: Back at home, in our quiet house, I take out the special gift that Mama bought just for me!
pages.alt: The child takes a gift out at home.
Wordless patterned spread of toys, balls, shoes and boots.
Wordless back cover with a small picture of the child sitting in a shopping trolley.
